metrics.method: Counts over all 1,773 non-service messages (1,052 client / 721 our side, 2025-08-25 to 2026-08-26). Questions = client messages containing '?', grouped into threads when <30 min apart. 'Unanswered >24h' = hand-checked threads where no on-topic our-side reply came within 24h (script found 1 by next-any-message; manual review added Jul 30 split-link ask 35h, Aug 7 Zelle-broken 40h, Mar 19 link ask 33h, Jun 24 split ask 5d, Aug 15 tags to Derrek never answered). Silence = longest gap between consecutive our-side messages; the 34-day figure excludes invoice and DMCA-screenshot posts (Stephski, Lauren, Nick, Michelle). Promises = explicit future commitments by our side ('will send', 'will update', 'you'll receive', 'last change I promise'); kept = delivered roughly on time, late = delivered >12h after an 'in a moment/one sec/2 hours' style promise, lapsed = never delivered or never closed out in chat.
